The workbook generation failed due to #NAME? errors in the statistics section, indicating invalid Excel formulas or missing named ranges.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numeric values (e.g., H46 expected -14.74, got #NAME?). While basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived statistics matrix failed the assert_matrix verifier.
